paragraphs: I’m grateful to you and I’m grateful to God for you. I’m grateful to have a friend that appreciates me as much as you do.
I’m grateful to have a friend that wakes up by 4am to see me off on my flight. I’m grateful to have a friend that won’t let a day pass without speaking to me.
I’m grateful to have a friend that pours into me as much as you do. I’m grateful to have a friend that isn’t scared to show the world how much he loves me.
I’m grateful to have a friend that doesn’t hesitate to recognize my beauty. I’m grateful to experience the love of Bryan Nii-Ayitey Benjamin-Addy.
closing: I’m grateful to have you. Happy birthday my Brucey.
I love you and I love you more.
